proposed_record.reviewerRationale: Volatus Aerospace is already a published Canadian uncrewed-systems organization. This bounded refresh adds two current public facts without changing its identity, capability model or mission mapping. Volatus's official July 8 release states that Transport Canada accepted its Canary RPAS under the Pre-Validated Declaration process. CanadaBuys separately lists Volatus Drones Canada as the July 9 recipient of a DFO Maritimes RPAS contract. The candidate deliberately preserves that supplier name and tells the reviewer not to assume legal-entity equivalence, a National Defence award, endorsement, customer interest or classified demand. Review the supplier-name relationship before accepting the DFO activity.
reviewWarnings: CanadaBuys names Volatus Drones Canada, while the published target is Volatus Aerospace; verify their legal or operating-name relationship before accepting this supplier-name activity.
The DFO RPAS award is a civil public-procurement record. It does not establish a National Defence contract, procurement eligibility, government endorsement, customer interest or classified demand.
